services.name: Drifter Fishing Excursions
services.desc: Our crews are all US Coast Guard Certified and our vessels are each equipped with the latest in electronics to assure safe and rewarding trips. The Drifter is a 60-foot long party fishing boat that has been family owned and operated for over 30 years. The finest in electronics for safety, navigation and fish finding have been installed to make your trips pleasant and safe. Everything that is needed for fishing is provided, including rod and reel, bait, instruction, and fishing license. The Drifter is located at Palmetto Bay Marina on the south end of Hilton Head.
